latest_release.name: Stryker V6.5.1
latest_release.body:
Crashes
- The terminal no longer crashes on launch. (#122, #126, #130)
- Saved networks opens again on devices where it crashed every time. Saved passwords are kept.

Handshake capture
- When airodump-ng reports a handshake, Stryker now checks the file first. If the handshake isn't there, it keeps listening instead of ending the attack.
- The capture is stopped cleanly, so the handshake actually reaches the file.
- Stopping a mass handshake capture no longer loses the last captured frames.
- "Handshake captured" is shown only when the file confirms it.

Cracking
- A running crack stays visible after you leave the screen. You can stop it there or from the notification.
- Cancel now actually stops aircrack-ng.
- Wordlists with spaces or quotes in the path open correctly.
- A failed run shows the real reason, such as a wordlist that won't open or a capture with no handshake, instead of "Password not found".
- Captures with several networks no longer hang.
- Deleting the last handshake no longer breaks the list. (#159)

Wi-Fi
- Monitor mode can be turned off again.
- RTL8187 adapters get more time to appear and are no longer reported as "driver missing". (#125)
- Pixie Dust says where the WPS exchange stopped instead of listing missing values. (#128)

Network scanner
- The root LAN scan lists every host nmap finds, including hosts behind a router or VPN. If the MAC is unknown, that field is left blank. (#127)
- On large networks, the first hosts are no longer dropped.
- Hosts with similar addresses, like .1 and .10, are no longer treated as the same host.

Rootless (VM)
- On slow devices, the VM keeps booting as long as the guest is making progress, instead of being stopped at 150 s. (#135)
- If port 2222 is taken, a free port is picked, and QEMU left over from a previous run is stopped first.
- VNC and other port forwards survive SSH reconnects.
- The guest core is no longer redeployed and restarted in a loop. (#120)
- UML: clearer error when there is no tmpfs for its memory. (#123)
- Clearer error when Android's sandbox (seccomp) blocks passt.
- Updated UML kernel, now more devices are supported and experimental fix for tp-link 722n v2/v3 is implemented

Saved networks
- Import skips broken rows instead of stopping at the first one.
- Export via root keeps passwords with apostrophes intact.
